dispatch_state

  frame aa22ac00000000000303c0014566000000300010045eff00000000000000000069fdb9
  expect_kind state

dispatch_caps

  frame aa29ac00000000000303b5071202010113020101140201011502010116020101170201001a020101dedb
  expect_kind capabilities

dispatch_caps_unsolicited

dispatch_unknown_id
